title: 第5章 豫省来了个作家
content_zh:
五点半，两家人才在梁婶儿的调解下偃旗息鼓。不过矛盾并没有解决，而是暂时被压制下来了。住房矛盾，哪里是那么好解决的。

    “济民，辛苦你了，要不是你在这儿啊，我真怕打起来！”梁婶儿看着人逐渐散去，夸奖道。

    刘济民用手抹了一下脸上的口水：“梁婶儿，我先回了。嗓门儿可真大，吵得我耳朵嗡嗡的。”

    “行，你赶紧回吧，我去西边转悠一下。哎呦，你是不知道，这胡同不大，事儿可不少。”梁婶儿说完，将绿色的头巾扎紧，扭着屁股快步朝着西边走去。

    刘济民慢悠悠地走在胡同里，仔细打量着这个时代。

    三十年后大家回想起七八十年代，总觉得一切都那么的温馨和美好，实际上贫穷和脏乱才是当时生活的底色。

    回忆是没有味道的，而现实则是到处都是流出的臭水。

    到了饭点了，胡同上空飘着无数缕炊烟，香味中夹杂着煤气味。

    刘济民不由得加快了回家的脚步，嘴里哼着自己改编的歌词儿：“燕京城，八百里，内蒙的风沙塞嘴里。燕京人说自己风沙大，蒙省人听了笑嘻嘻....”

    通过狭窄的夹道回到大杂院，刘济民就闻到了煮萝卜的味道。王爱梅正在包鸡蛋萝卜馅的素饺，见刘济民回来了，笑着用勺子挖了一勺饺子馅，让刘济民尝尝味道怎么样。

    “好吃，咸淡正好。”刘济民忍不住又挖了一勺。

    王爱梅笑骂道：“瞧你馋的，洗洗手，去擀皮儿去。”

    “我再吃一口。”刘济民嘿嘿一笑。萝卜鸡蛋加上粉条，味道吃起来很不错。

    “包一半素扁食，再包一半猪肉萝卜扁食，估计够吃了。”王爱梅看着刘济民，心里叹了口气，要是肉多点就好了。

    豫省人称饺子为扁食。

    刘济民挽起袖筒洗了洗手，擦干净后开始擀饺子皮。案板放在屋子里的高桌上，等饺子包好，用排子端到门口的砖灶上煮熟。

    两人干活做得飞快，过了一会儿，刘振国也加入了做饭小组。
content_en:
At half past five, the two families came to an end under Aunt Liang's mediation. However, the conflict was not resolved, but was temporarily suppressed. The housing conflict is so easy to resolve.

    "Jimin, thank you for your hard work. If you weren't here, I would have been afraid of a fight!" Aunt Liang praised as she watched the people gradually disperse.

    Liu Jimin wiped the saliva on his face with his hand: "Aunt Liang, I'll get back first. The voice was so loud that it made my ears buzz."

    "Okay, hurry up and go back. I'll go to the west side for a while. Hey, you don't know, this alley is not big, but there is a lot going on." After Aunt Liang said that, she tied the green headscarf tightly, twisted her butt and walked quickly towards the west side.

    Liu Jimin walked slowly in the alley and looked at this era carefully.

    Thirty years later, when everyone looks back on the 1970s and 1980s, they always feel that everything was so warm and beautiful. In fact, poverty and chaos were the background of life at that time.

    Memories are tasteless, while reality is smelly water flowing out everywhere.

    When it was time for dinner, countless wisps of cooking smoke floated over the alley, and the aroma was mixed with the smell of gas.

    Liu Jimin couldn't help but speed up his pace home, humming the lyrics he adapted: "Yanjing City, eight hundred miles away, Inner Mongolia's wind and sand fills his mouth. People in Yanjing say they have strong winds and sand, and people in Mongolia smile after hearing this..."

    After returning to the courtyard through the narrow passage, Liu Jimin smelled the smell of boiled radishes. Wang Aimei was making vegetarian dumplings filled with eggs and radish. When she saw Liu Jimin coming back, she smiled and took a spoonful of the dumpling filling to let Liu Jimin taste it.

    "It's delicious, just right." Liu Jimin couldn't help but take another spoonful.

    Wang Aimei laughed and scolded: "Look at how greedy you are, wash your hands and go roll the dough."

    "I'll take another bite." Liu Jimin chuckled. The radish eggs and vermicelli taste delicious.

    "It's half vegetarian and half pork and radish. It's probably enough to eat." Wang Aimei looked at Liu Jimin and sighed inwardly. It would be better if there was more meat.

    People in Henan Province call dumplings flat food.

    Liu Jimin rolled up his sleeves and washed his hands, wiped them clean and started rolling out the dumpling wrappers. The chopping board is placed on the high table in the room, and when the dumplings are wrapped, they are brought to the brick stove at the door and cooked on a chopstick.

    The two worked quickly, and after a while, Liu Zhenguo also joined the cooking team.
title_en: Chapter 5 A writer comes from Henan Province
